text.description_html:
Reguitti SDK096PA-P22 Matte Black Contemporary Rectangle Pocket Door Pull Set

All new contemporary rectangular sliding pocket door passage set that offers both fashion and high quality function. Packaged as a complete flush pull set that includes two (2) rectangle flush pulls, a square edge pull and all mounting hardware. Made in Italy by Reguitti. This Matte Black Contemporary Rectangle Pocket Door Pull Set will fit both 1-3/8 inch and 1-3/4 inch thick pocket doors. The edge pull is pressure mounted into the doors edge. The rectangle flush pulls are installed with concealed screw mounting for that clean contemporary appearance.

Pocket Door Passage Function: This set neither locks nor latches. It features two flush pulls and finger edge pull to help retrieve the door from the pocket.

Specifications for the SDK096PA Contemporary Rectangle Pocket Door Passage Set:

  • Finish: Matte Black
  • Total Height: 4-15/16"
  • Total Width: 1-1/2"
  • Total Depth: 1/2"
  • Door Cutout Depth: 3/8"
  • Projection: 3/16"
  • Door Cutout Height: 3-5/16"
  • Door Cutout Width: 1-1/8"
  • Edge Pull Diameter: 1-1/8" Square
  • SDK096PA Dimensions (PDF)

*Note: The flush pulls project 3/16" off the door's face. If you intend to use on a pocket door, please insure that you have more than 3/16" clearance between the door's face and the wall pocket.

Sold as a Set: two (2) rectangle flush pulls, square edge pull and all mounting hardware. For One (1) Door.

Special order. No returns.
